title: MAD Chairs: A new tool to evaluate AI

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating LLM strategy recommendations in an abstract, multi-player resource allocation game (MAD Chairs) to determine if models establish unequal hierarchies (a caste system) rather than cooperative turn-taking.

Analyzing model outputs in the MAD Chairs game to see if the AI recommends systematically excluding a specific player (treating them as a 'non-learner') to artificially boost the win rates of the remaining ingroup players.
